name: Right triangles
description: Find a missing side of a right triangle with the Pythagorean theorem.
solve: function solve(q){const t=q.toLowerCase();const n=(t.match(/\d+(\.\d+)?/g)||[]).map(Number);if(n.length<2)return{answer:null,reason:'Need two sides.'};const f=v=>+v.toFixed(4);if(/hypotenuse (is|of|=)\s*\d|hypotenuse\s+\d|with hypotenuse/.test(t)&&!/find (the )?hypotenuse|what is the hypotenuse/.test(t)){const hm=t.match(/hypotenuse\s*(?:is|of|=)?\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/);const c=+hm[1],a=n.find(x=>x!==c);const b=Math.sqrt(c*c-a*a);return{answer:`missing leg = ${f(b)}`,steps:[`b = √(c² − a²) = √(${c}² − ${a}²)`,`= ${f(b)}`]}}const[a,b]=n;const c=Math.sqrt(a*a+b*b);return{answer:`hypotenuse = ${f(c)}`,steps:[`c = √(a² + b²) = √(${a}² + ${b}²) = √${a*a+b*b}`,`= ${f(c)}`]}}
